name: FNSS ACV-15 (AIFV/AAPC)
armament: 25 mm Oerlikon cannon in one-man turret (AIFV)
protection: Aluminium hull with spaced laminate steel appliqué. Game rule: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: M113-like box hull with sloped upper sides and bolted spaced armour panels
5 road wheels per side, front drive sprocket
Small turret offset to the right; rear power ramp with door
Firing ports with vision blocks along the sides
